title: GC–EI–MS Annotation Tool
description: GC–EI–MS software for tentative annotation of electron-ionization mass spectra. The current application uses an 8,455-connectivity reference library and a twelve-feature reliability model, supporting single-spectrum and batch input, ranked candidate review, confidence screening and CSV output. Publisher-reported database labels are not independently confirmed chemical identities, and screening criteria do not guarantee future error rates. Retention-index integration is not provided.
